about:
Country Pure Foods is headquartered in Akron, Ohio, and traces its origins to 1995 when a private equity firm merged two regional portion‑juice companies, Ohio Pure Foods and Natural Country Farms, to form Country Pure Farms. The business later rebranded as Country Pure Foods and is now partnered with private‑equity firm Blue Point Capital Partners LLC.

The company manufactures portioned and multi‑serve juices, plant‑based beverages, and frozen novelties. Through a series of acquisitions — including Ardmore Farms (1998), Vitality’s portion‑products division (2006), Cal Tex Citrus (2012), Quality Kitchens (2014), Ridgefield’s Brand Corp (2016), and Silver Springs Citrus (2017) — it has built a national production footprint with facilities in multiple states. It operates as a large‑scale co‑packer and private‑label supplier, offering a broad line of beverage products and packaging formats.

Its customers span foodservice (restaurants, healthcare, K‑12 schools), retail, and co‑pack channels. Brands such as Ardmore Farms and SideKicks are sold directly to schools and foodservice distributors, while private‑label products serve retail and foodservice accounts nationwide.

The company states its mission is to “champion success by delivering unparalleled food and beverage solutions.” It emphasizes its position as the largest supplier of portion juice to the foodservice industry, a diverse supplier base, and SQF certification as markers of quality and reliability.
